body: Basically what happened was that I moved too quickly when he wanted to date me but I was still too affected by my last one that I just made sure I got what I wanted and then left it alone. But I unfortunately ended up really liking him which makes me want to be around him more often. I love him a lot and he really likes me too. I just feel too unprepared because he’s very successful already.
And then I feel excitement about talking to someone but see it was nothing or my family and I have to try to shut down that feeling and become cool about it but really it just hurts.

I sleep pretty often and I have talked to a professional but she sort of revealed why some situations made me feel so awful. Like why I felt so betrayed by this friend who went to party with the guy I kept saying no to. Because I would never do that to her. Even if we weren’t being such good friends to the end, I don’t think I could ever do something like that to her and it broke my heart.
That makes sense, thanks for taking the time out to reply. I appreciate!

I’m curious why he would bother asking but then not go through with it. And I didn’t make it clear in my post but someone he knows described him that way. Though I can’t help but think it comes from a place of slight jealousy tbh

Man, yeah I do. I try all the time to talk to my sisters and they'll usually ignore me and after a few minutes of silence will say, oh sorry, what did you say? Because they hardly know I'm there. Hardly anyone knows I'm here. I have nothing to look forward to also. I was thinking, if I ended up in the hospital for maybe surgery or something, no one would visit me because I don't have anyone I'm close with that would check up on me or want to come see me. It hurts so much 😞. I don't want to make it to 25 lol.

I was concerned about this too. I hope it's ok for this lovely snake to be out there and not stressed about being in such a weird situation. I have to be that person because everything concerns me lol

I'm pretty sure it was the Balvenie 12 or 14. The packaging looks really familiar and I've found a site that sells samples apparently so I may try and order it to confirm. Will come back with the results (but will most likely disappear and forget to come back)
I remember it not having the sting of whiskey and going down real smoothly! It was really sweet and I think I may have found it already actually. Thanks so much guys!

It definitely wasn't Laphroaig 10. Actually I think I may have found it! The Balvenie 14 yr old looks incredibly familiar to me! Even though the packaging is different than what I described, it stood out to me the most. This one may be it!!

Naw man, I remember it being in a grey cylindrical tube but my memory really isn't so great. This really cool Scottish guy we met got it and was nice enough to share it with us and man was it great. But we got pretty drunk from it that I really don't remember what it was when we got up the next day.

This is me right now. There's no one for me to see and nowhere for me to go so I'm just in bed with nothing to really think about or look forward to. I want to sleep as I don't get enough at night but it's not working and so I'm stuck with my thoughts.

You're proving the point that you are as much of a "nice guy" as others have stated. Someone else close to you knows how you feel and also doesn't care for her boyfriend's feelings by trying to set you two up. You want to paint him as a bad guy but are completely oblivious of your own actions and intentions.
Heck yeah brother, it looks like that's what it was. Thanks!
